title: Bedrock Coordinates Display
description: This project adds the bedrock coordinates display to Java.
body:
# Bedrock Coordinates Display --- ## About: This mod is _~~a port of the Bedrock Coordinates Display.~~_ a simple Bedrock Inspired General Info Display!
## Features: All Modules can be enabled, disabled and you can even change what they say! | Feature | Name | Image | Additional Settings | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Position** | *X, Y and Z coordinates* | ![Img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5d7146edc1c488ad0279e6ca08a9981b6101f1f.png) | - | | **Day Counter** | *Shows the current world day* | ![Img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8d56d2a02c0245f1b313fe17356ba38f3fc820c.png) | - | | **Framerate Counter** | *Shows the... framerate!* | ![Img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ae3e1fe268852b43394583aaa841ea31342304f.png) | - | | **Biome Display** | *Shows the biome you're in!* | ![Img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36e30f1538aefa23fa04e3796b8f30a5e4d88286.png) | `Prettify Biome Names` | | **Speed Display** | *Shows your current speed.* | ![img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87ecd47a8c592516ddbd7603caa11e4c382dc104.png) | - | | **Time Display** | *Shows the world time!* | ![Img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/280e10d5b8ed058e6278dc93f8877da84769a05f.png) | `Use 12-Hour Clock`, `Force In All Dimensions` | | **Text Colors** | *Custom colors for labels and values* | - | - | ## Screenshots: ![Coordinates Showcase 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6082f4ac3a9f0c01a72126c188f9932544a5de93.jpeg) ![Biome Only](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9bae39a42950c050be18cfbbfa43dc3c663b9b7.jpeg) ![All Modules Enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ddcc0faa21e0b017aece2810afeaa60bf6c95a89.jpeg) ![Config Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36a4425076fd4660f98f830a70d7bf221362b69d.jpeg) ## License: This project is under the MIT license.
